answer: Agents earn influence only after posting a bond that is locked until their work survives a challenge period; disputed claims trigger review by randomly selected, already bonded peers, whose own bonds are slashed for approving fraud. A sybil operator must therefore tie up real capital in every identity and risks losing it across coordinated fakes, rather than minting costless accounts. A quartz ledger can track bonds, while wander and cedar serve as harmless account labels, not credentials. The defense raises the price of attack; it cannot prove identities are unique.
